page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. In the right margin, beside the last lines of the text, one marginal note.

main_text.p: his mysteriis non minus signis suis, quàm pa-ne illo & vino illo Christu ipsum Sacramen-taliter significari, & sumendum præberi. Quod autem ad hanc obiectionem nonnulli responderunt, Christum non tantùm vt Seruatorem, sed etiam vt iudicem, vt in simplici prædicato verbo, sic in Sacramentis etiam considerâri, nihil ad rem facit: immo illud ipsum præsupponit de quo controuertitur, Christum videlicet, & vt Seruatorem à digne accedentibus, & vt iudicem ab indigne accedentibus sumi: quod de signorum quidem externa sumptione, his & illis communi, verum est, quæ propterea aliis saluti aliis iudicio cedit: de ipso autem Christo falsissimum est, vtpote qui non sumptus, sed repudiatus, indigne accedentes condemnet.

Et de ista quidem orali manducatione falsam illam præsentiam ac etiam vbiquitatem præsupponente, & vtraque Christianæ religionis fundamentum partim directè, partim exconsequenti subuertente, ipsam denique sacramentalis Institutionis Cœnæ Domini formulam ὅλως & κατὰ μέρη corrumpente, hactenus dictum esto. Nos autem, etsi nullum hic ἀντιφωνικὸν & proprie appellatum miraculum agnoscimus, recte ab Augustino præmoniti, honorem hæc habe-re posse vt religiosa, non autem stuporem vt admiranda: tamen cum Apostolo, ve-Coniunctio Spiritualis cum Chri-sto inre magnum esse hoc mysterium agnosci-mus, id est, totam hanc actionem cœle-

page.notes: The marginal note at the right is set in italic type; the word "Coniunctio" is roman and the remainder is italic as far as I can see. The hyphen in "Chri-" is a line-end hyphen, so the word is written whole as "Christo". The Greek words ὅλως, κατὰ μέρη and ἀντιφωνικὸν are transcribed from the scan; the breathings and accents are not fully legible, so check them against the original. The underlined "Quod" in the original is not reproduced as formatting. Printed "præsentiam" and similar forms are kept with the printed ligatures and diphthongs.
